notes: The 10-epoch visual+handcrafted checkpoint selected by best validation loss slightly beat the mean-condition baseline on descriptor MSE.
The final epoch metrics for both 10-epoch trained variants were worse than the mean-condition baseline, indicating instability/overfit on a small validation split.
The handcrafted-only final epoch was better than the visual+handcrafted final epoch, but the visual+handcrafted best checkpoint was used for MVP-2 generation artifacts.
